From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-29T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: unattended session — we were in the room

Hey Michael,

We were in the meeting room and didn't see any attendees join. No worries — things happen. Two quick questions so we can triage before rebooking:

- Did your team receive the calendar invite link (hangouts/Zoom)?
- Is there an internal firewall or allowlist that might block outbound connections to our runtime region (us-west-2)?

If the issue is an expired token, I'm happy to rotate the API key on our end and generate a temporary credential for you to try. If it's a network block, Soojin (cc'd) can help with an allowlist checklist we usually send to infra teams.

I've attached the checklist and a short one-pager on how we rotate keys safely. If you can reply with what failed (link vs. token vs. firewall) I'll schedule a new 45-minute slot and include the right folks.

Attachments: onboarding-checklist.pdf; api-key-rotation-instructions.txt

Thanks,
Markus

On Mon, 29 Mar 2027 at 09:12, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick reminder that we have a 30-minute integration office hours slot today at 10:00 AM PT...
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-29T11:10:00-07:00
Subject: FW: unattended session — quick infra triage suggestions

Markus / Monica,

If the external infra team suspects network filtering, ask them to verify the following quickly before we rebook:

- Outbound ports 443 allowed to runtime endpoints in us-west-2 (list in drive link)
- DNS resolution of api.redwood-inference.com from their CI/CD hosts
- No corporate proxy intercepting TLS (we've seen a couple orgs terminate TLS at the proxy which breaks cert pinning)

If they share a network trace we can usually point to the failing hop (I attached a small trace snippet template they can populate). If token rotation is the issue, Markus — go ahead and rotate a short-lived key; I'll prepare the allowlist checklist to send over.

Soojin Lee
Customer Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Attachments: network-trace-snippet.txt
From: Michael Shaw <michael.shaw@auroraanalytics.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: devops@auroraanalytics.com
Date: 2027-03-30T07:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: unattended session — we were in the room

Hi Markus,

Apologies — our on-call rotated overnight and the engineer who was supposed to join didn't pick up the invite. When they did try to join from our staging host they immediately saw 403s on the SDK bootstrap and then our CI team rotated the key as a precaution.

I've attached a tiny snippet of the client logs and the trace our infra team captured; it looks like the staging host is behind a corporate proxy that is rewriting TLS and our request to api.redwood-inference.com is getting a 403 after the proxy modifies headers. We'll need the allowlist checklist and a new short-lived key to test.

Can we please rebook for tomorrow (Mar 31) at either 9 AM PT or 1 PM PT? If neither works we'll propose a few other slots.

Thanks,
Michael Shaw
Senior Platform Engineer | Aurora Analytics
michael.shaw@auroraanalytics.com
